findings.passage: The House just voted in favor of overriding the Governor's veto of Senate Bill 2- Voter ID. This legislation protects the integrity of our elections, and ensures that each ballot will be cast in a manner that is secure and fair. It passed 60-29. #kyga20
findings.note: Her post on the night the House overrode the Governor's veto of SB 2, the 2020 voter-ID law; she says the law protects election integrity.

findings.passage: People should be able to vote without photo identification. Strongly Disagree
findings.note: Questionnaire for the 2022 general election (iVoterGuide). The statement is "People should be able to vote without photo identification." and her ticked answer is "Strongly Disagree".

findings.passage: I would ensure that voting machines cannot be connected to the internet, and that voting must take place in-person on Election Day unless there is a verifiable reason for an absentee ballot: Serving overseas, surgery, disability, major illness, out of town, etc.
findings.note: Her written answer to "What laws would you propose to change present voting practices?" in the same 2022 questionnaire: in-person voting on Election Day unless a verifiable reason for an absentee ballot.
